annotations.title: Facts about an employer and its hiring

description: Facts about an employer and its hiring. For "tell me about Monzo as an employer", "is Tesco hiring?", "how big is this company?". Gives what the company does, when it was founded, staff numbers, headquarters and website (from Wikidata), UK company records when available (Companies House, Open Government Licence), how many jobs it has open now with examples, and ready searches for people there. Staff reviews are not included. For US employers it adds what they offered on US work visa filings.

name.description: The company name, for example "Monzo" or "Tesco".

where.description: Optional place to narrow its open jobs, for example London.

name: company_lookup
